job_location: Hong Kong, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan
responsibilities: Own your domains end to end - a single named owner from the data to the dashboard to the conversation with the stakeholder asking the question.
Deliver value-added analysis for your domains: pricing and cost-saving analyses, forecasting, client deep-dives, and proposals that shape commercial decisions.

Identify and quantify revenue opportunities and growth levers such as pricing optimization, upsell/cross-sell potential, retention drivers, and margin expansion and translate them into clear recommendations for business owners.
Partner with your domains’ business teams as embedded decision support in the meetings and shaping the decisions, not working a ticket queue.
Turn recurring questions into permanent answers: every repeat request becomes a new column, dashboard, or documentation entry asked once, never again.
Design and maintain your domains’ vetted views and metric definitions in our Snowflake semantic layer the definitions all three access paths read from.
Build and own your domains’ Metabase dashboards, and keep their numbers trustworthy: validated, reconciled against Finance-owned figures, and debugged to root cause when they drift.
Run your domains’ enablement documentation, training sessions, weekly office hours, and Slack support so stakeholders self-serve the routine questions.
Collaborate with Data Engineering on ingestion and modeling decisions, and with Data Product Managers on priorities and rollout.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: The rigor financial data demands: validation, reconciliation, and chasing discrepancies to root cause.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Correctness language dominates — "The rigor financial data demands: validation, reconciliation, and chasing discrepancies to root cause." — with no speed or shipping vocabulary anywhere in the posting.
evidence.domain_risk: Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong, with teams across multiple countries.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Fintech is a default-high sector and the JD confirms it with explicit financial framing, requiring numbers "reconciled against Finance-owned figures" on card, payment and settlement data.
evidence.collaboration_width: upstream engineers; data engineers; data product managers; Finance
evidence.data_team_maturity: You’ll report to our Analytics Lead under the Data & Analytics functional team and work day-to-day with upstream engineers, data engineers, fellow analytics engineers, and data product managers in a distributed, async-friendly team.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The data function is already split into specialised roles with distinct charters — an Analytics Lead, data engineers, analytics engineers and data product managers — with a governed semantic layer in place.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and maintain your domains’ vetted views and metric definitions in our Snowflake semantic layer the definitions all three access paths read from.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets name the warehouse, the BI tool, the three consumption paths and the weekly rituals ("weekly office hours, and Slack support"), so the day-to-day is fully legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You’ll surface revenue opportunities and margin-improvement levers through structured analyses of pricing, discounts, product mix, client profitability, and usage patterns, turning data into actionable commercial recommendations.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is the commercial side — pricing, upsell/cross-sell, retention and client profitability "translate them into clear recommendations for business owners".
evidence.autonomy_level: Own your domains end to end - a single named owner from the data to the dashboard to the conversation with the stakeholder asking the question.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is framed as domain ownership that shapes decisions — "in the meetings and shaping the decisions, not working a ticket queue" — rather than delivering scoped requests.
evidence.ai_role: Experience with / or strong interest in AI-assisted analytics: LLM tooling, skill/prompt design, or text-to-SQL over governed data.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The semantic layer the candidate maintains is what an AI answering path reads from — "AI-assisted answers through Claude all reading from a single governed semantic layer" — so the candidate's output is upstream of the AI, with text-to-SQL named as a nice-to-have.
evidence.testing_framing: Build and own your domains’ Metabase dashboards, and keep their numbers trustworthy: validated, reconciled against Finance-owned figures, and debugged to root cause when they drift.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is owned, not tooled — the candidate keeps numbers "validated, reconciled ... and debugged to root cause", with no testing product named in that framing.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: The rigor financial data demands: validation, reconciliation, and chasing discrepancies to root cause.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trustworthiness is a primary framing of the role and the fear is wrong financial numbers reaching business owners, repeated as reconciliation against Finance and root-cause debugging of drift.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: we’re not hiring someone to answer questions one at a time, but someone who builds the system that answers them permanently
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The team "is building a self-service analytics platform" and the role's infrastructure verbs are design and build — new vetted views, new dashboards, new documentation — rather than repair of an existing estate.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is financial-trust led: "The rigor financial data demands: validation, reconciliation, and chasing discrepancies to root cause." reinforced by the duty to keep dashboard numbers "validated, reconciled against Finance-owned figures, and debugged to root cause when they drift."
